Job Description
This is an in office role that is responsible for providing customers, retail personnel, and insurance companies detailed information regarding invoices and explanations of balance due.
What Would You Do? The Specifics.
Answers calls from customers regarding collection of past account accounts. Conducts conference calls with customers and insurance companies to determine the the responsible party for the balance and offers solutions of payment options.
Provides detailed notes in our Point of System to communicate findings to retail associates and maintains notes in the ticketing system to track calls and the purpose of calls.
Answers calls from retail personnel to assist with selecting the correct plans in the Point of Sale system and answer questions regarding plan calculations and why their customers received balance due notices.
Writes off balance per store requests concerning store errors and forwards new plans to the Plan Setup Team to add into the Point of Sale.
Answers calls from third-party payers and reviews line by line the details in order to determine the customer's responsibility and insurance responsibility.
Completes a high-balance investigation to find new ways to prevent bad billings by researching insurance plans and insurance information. Makes outbound calls to insurance companies to inquire about the status of unpaid self-pay claims.
Solves issues with insurance checks that go directly to the customers but belong to National Vision (NVI) by calling out to the customers to explain their balances owed.

High School Diploma or equivalent. (Required)

GS-07: You qualify at the GS-07 level if you possess one (1) year of specialized experience, which is equivalent to at least the GS-05 level in the federal government, that equipped you with the skills needed to successfully perform the duties of the position.

OR You may substitute successful completion of one year of fulltime graduate education for the experience required at the GS-07 level. This education must have been obtained from an accredited college or university and demonstrate the skills necessary to do the work of the position.

Check with your school to determine how many credit hours comprise a year of graduate education. If that information is not available, use 18 semester or 27 quarter hours. OR You may also substitute superior academic achievement for the experience required at the GS-07 level.

You must have completed the requirements for a Bachelor's degree from an accredited college or university with either: (1) class standing in the upper third of a graduating class or major subdivision; or, (2) a grade point average of 3.0 or higher on a 4.0 scale based on four (4) years of education or the final two (2) years; or, (3) a grade point average of 3.5 or higher out of a possible 4.0 based on the average of the required courses completed in the major field or the required courses in the major field completed during the final two (2) years of the curriculum; or, (4) membership in a national scholastic honor society.

GS-09: You qualify at the GS-09 level if you possess one (1) year of specialized experience, which is equivalent to at least the GS-07 level in the federal government, that equipped you with the skills needed to successfully perform the duties of the position.

You must have experience performing the majority of the following duties: Submitting requests for personnel actions to be entered into employee records. Assisting in the facilitation of orientation for new employees. Monitoring the usage of government motor vehicles by employees for analysis and reporting.

Recommending solutions to administrative problems. Advising office staff on established methods and/or procedures.

Assisting with the facilitation of office seat and telephone service relocation OR You may substitute a Master's degree or two (2) full years of graduate education leading to such a degree in any field, or a J.D. or L.L.B. degree for experience required at the GS-09 grade level.

Such education must have been obtained in an accredited college or university and demonstrate the knowledge, skills, and abilities necessary to do the work of this position. Check with your school to determine how many credit hours comprise two years of graduate education. If that information is not available, use 36 semester or 54 quarter hours.

As the Manager, Quality Assurance within Customer Support, you will play a key role in shaping how we measure, maintain, and improve the quality of our customer experience across every support interaction.

You’ll lead the evolution of our QA program, helping define the frameworks, processes, and operational strategies that enable our teams to deliver consistent, high-quality support at scale.

By leveraging AI-powered QA tooling, you’ll surface actionable insights, identify emerging themes, and help drive continuous improvements in support quality and team performance.
Our QA program is still in its early stages, with foundational processes already in place but significant opportunity to iterate, expand, and mature the function over time. This role is ideal for someone who thrives in evolving environments and is excited by the opportunity to help shape a modern QA program while balancing strategic ownership with hands-on execution.
Reporting into Customer Support leadership, you will partner closely with Support Operations, frontline leaders, Enablement, Product, and other cross-functional teams to identify opportunities for operational improvement, coaching, and quality enhancements across the customer journey. You’ll help establish scalable QA methodologies, calibration practices, reporting structures, and feedback loops that drive accountability and continuous improvement throughout the organization.
In this role, you’ll also help shape how QA supports AI-powered customer experiences. As AI-assisted workflows and responses continue to evolve, you’ll evaluate both human and AI-generated customer interactions to ensure quality, consistency, accuracy, and alignment with the customer experience we aim to deliver. Your ability to identify trends, uncover friction points, and drive targeted quality initiatives will directly influence both team effectiveness and customer experience.
This role has the potential to evolve into direct people leadership of QA specialists or QA team leads as the function grows.
How we’re using AI today
Across GTM, we’re transforming the way we work with AI. We expect every seller, CSM, and team member to become a power user, using it daily to work smarter and move faster.

AI is already embedded in how we operate – from real-time coaching that sharpens how we sell and interact with customers, to surfacing insights that help us anticipate needs – creating more time for meaningful customer engagement. If you’re excited to reshape how you think, make decisions, and drive growth with AI, you’ll feel right at home here.
This is a remote opportunity within Canada and the US.

Company Description
Lingraphica is a mission-driven organization that provides speech-generating devices to help improve communication, speech, and quality of life for people with communication impairments.

Lingraphica is a leader in augmentative and alternative communication (AAC) technology, helping people with aphasia and other speech and language impairments communicate and engage more fully in daily life.

Through a combination of innovative devices, software, and services, Lingraphica is focused on improving communication outcomes and supporting individuals, families, and care teams. We look for candidates who enjoy working in a fast-paced, goal-oriented environment, and who share our commitment to helping individuals on their communication journey.
Job Description
Purpose : The Customer Service Specialist (CSS) successfully works with prospects and existing customers by offering a world-class experience throughout all points of contact. This role collaborates cross-functionally with teams across Lingraphica’s business units to improve customer-facing channels.

The CSS is responsible for addressing non-product inquiries, resolving Tier 1 issues, and properly triaging and escalating customer concerns. Tier 1 issues include basic troubleshooting for all Lingraphica products such as free apps, customer accounts, and devices.

This position is responsible for providing exceptional customer service in a timely manner.

Maintains knowledge of all product enhancements, website improvements, marketing campaigns, and other developments that may impact frontline volume across all channels
Comfortably interacts with prospects and existing customers by providing a superb experience to both create and maintain relationships/partnerships
Identifies and provides a resolution for Tier 1 product issues Lingraphica customers are experiencing
Proactively follows up with customers to ensure their concerns are resolved
Communicates with potential and existing customers through multiple platforms including inbound calls, outbound calls, e-mail and online chat
Monitors and reports customer inquiry trends, recurring issues, and frontline insights using CRM data to support operational improvements and enhance the customer experience.
Effectively liaises with key functions such as Reimbursement, Funding & Benefits, and Product Support to improve customer-facing processes or services
Recognizes opportunities to support customer progression by identifying potential engagement needs and ensuring timely handoff to the appropriate team.
Manages frontline activities using a ticket system to document issues, opportunities, and “transfers” to departments for follow-up
Assists with de-escalating customer service matters including but not limited to:
Technical issues with our devices, websites, online therapy platform
Shipping
Provides support to other customer service areas such as communication partner training, and product support teams
Provides education on Lingraphica's products, services, and trial process while identifying engagement opportunities and appropriately connecting prospective customers with the Intake & Engagement team for consultative follow-up.
Maintains an expert knowledge of Lingraphica devices, accessories, web programs, and mobile applications
Maintains an understanding of the pre-trial sales journey and collaborates with Intake & Engagement and Trial Onboarding teams to ensure a seamless customer experience across all pre-trial touchpoints.
Conduct proactive customer outreach from designated campaign lists to check in on customers' communication progress, device experience, and support needs, connecting them with additional services, technical resources, or other appropriate next steps when applicable.

Knowledge, Skills & Abilities
Curious thinker with a desire to improve existing processes
Excellent communication skills (written, verbal and listening)
Ability to assist individuals who have aphasia and other speech/language challenges with empathy and compassion
Able and eager to deliver a positive customer experience
Excellent time management and multi-tasking skills
Ability to perform above expectations in a fastpaced and dynamic environment
Teamwork, especially as an expert at getting things done, all with a positive attitude

Bachelor’s Degree, preferred, or equivalent combination of education and experience
2 years Customer Service experience, required

About Clipboard
Our mission is to uplift as many communities as possible. We do this through our app-based marketplace that connects healthcare professionals with the workplaces that need amazing workers. This enables hundreds of thousands of people to achieve financial stability for themselves and their families while providing essential care to millions of people across the U.S.
Founded in 2016, we are a remote-first team of over 1,000 people building a top Y-Combinator company and have been profitable since 2022. We’re the leader in Long-Term Care staffing and are rapidly expanding into Home Health, Hospitals, and more, meaning we have more work to do than people to do it, and are growing our team to support millions more people and their communities.

Worker Operations is the team that owns end-to-end operations and support for the supply-side (the workers) of our marketplace. We are over 200 team members who serve the 400,000+ (and growing) active professionals on our marketplace. As a Worker Operations Team Lead your primary role is to be an exceptional coach for your team.
Your responsibility is to provide agents with constructive feedback, identify the root causes of performance issues, and train them to address and correct those problems.

You maintain high standards for your team and aren’t afraid to say, “This needs improvement, and here’s why.” You ensure that the customer experience remains the focal point of every discussion, set SMART goals for performance improvement, and deliver feedback that aligns with our standards.

You’re also hands-on, willing to dive into customer issues directly, and you become a product expert so that you can coach your agents effectively.

Closely monitoring agent performance, primarily in terms of quality, productivity, and attendance metrics, with a primary goal of maintaining quality assurance scores above 9%
Providing frequent coaching to agents based QA feedback, metrics, customer survey responses, and your own ticket observations
Occasionally handling angry customer escalations
Ensure schedule adherence by agents and desired productivity levels
Maintaining coaching logs and providing regular written feedback to agents
Comfortably navigate our support environment, which includes tools such as Zendesk, Metabase, and Amazon Connect
Listen to team members’ feedback and resolve any challenges or conflicts
Initiate consequence management steps in the case of low-performing team members
Delegate tasks to high potential team members to build a culture of learning and development in the team
Suggest and lead team building activities for team motivation
Experience
2+ years of coaching experience – Demonstrated success coaching individuals through structured feedback, development planning, and performance improvement.
2+ years of people management experience – Experience leading customer support teams, driving performance, engagement, and accountability.
2+ years of customer support experience – Strong foundation in delivering exceptional customer service and resolving complex customer issues.
What Success Looks Like in Worker Operations
Customer obsessed – Puts workers at the centre of every decision and consistently delivers a world-class experience.
Data-driven problem solver – Uses data, trends, and root cause analysis to identify issues and deliver sustainable improvements.
Thrives in ambiguity – Adapts quickly to changing priorities, products, and processes while maintaining high performance.
Communicates with clarity – Shares information proactively, aligns stakeholders, and provides clear, actionable feedback.
Bias for action – Takes ownership, moves with urgency, and focuses on delivering outcomes over perfection.
Continuously learns – Quickly develops expertise in new tools, products, and processes, applying that knowledge to improve both personal and team performance.
Raises the talent bar – Invests in coaching, challenges others to improve, and builds a culture of accountability and excellence.
Resilient under pressure – Maintains sound judgement and consistent execution during periods of high volume, incidents, and operational change.

Every year, we sponsor 2 remote UX apprentices from anywhere in the world to join us for 7 months, either in the fall or spring seasons or online. Our UX apprentices work through the end-to-end UX design and UX research process for a startup idea of their choice that will help them attract hiring managers in that topic space or industry.
Apprentices take our program for free and receive 1:1 mentorship throughout the 7-month program. Alumni UX apprentices go on to make between $85,000 -$130,000 in UX design, product design, UX research, or service design roles after they complete the program.
We are committed to helping women, immigrants, POC, and LGBTQ folks break into tech and land 6-figure UX jobs. We help you land 6-figure UX jobs or coach you till you get it.

This apprenticeship program is open to new grads and UX career changers alike! Here are some apprenticeship requirements to keep in mind before applying:

Interested in creative career paths in UX research, UX design, product design or service design
Willing to commit 5-10 hours of work per week to complete program deliverables
Willing to attend 2-3 hour weekend lectures to learn the end-to-end design process OR willing to complete online video course modules
Open to feedback from UX mentors and demonstrates a willingness to revise design work

Build digital products and services 0-1
Lead end-to-end design process for a startup idea or topic of your choice
Lead product scoping and feature scoping, as well as entire project management
Identify target market for product and position product for launch success
Incorporate AI tools into your UX design process
Design AI features and products by considering AI specific design parameters and heuristics
Understand how AI works and advocate for ethical AI design that builds trust without over-reliance with users
Develop a business model for the product or service and demonstrate how the product/service will scale as the business model scales
Lead discovery research by managing user recruitment, creating research plans, writing interview guides, leading 8-16 discovery interviews, and synthesizing interview insights
Deliver a compelling UX design and business pitch for your startup idea, showcasing both qualitative and quantitative data to justify the problem space and the solution
Tell a compelling story about users by showcasing user types, personas, stakeholder maps, journey maps, process maps, service blueprints, ideation matrixes, sketches, wireframes, UX workflows, prototypes and other visual deliverables
Lead user testing of wireframes and prototypes to improve product/service usability and constantly iterate on your startup idea
Design a unique design system for your solution from scratch, creating components, a style guide, and branding for your solution
Analyze direct and indirect competitors to clearly articulate your solution’s differentiators and why your solution is innovative and more likely to succeed over competing options
Consult with startups to create a scope of work and fulfill UX research, UX design, product design and service design work based on your scope of work.

Please fill out our application form to apply for UX Woman sponsoring your participation in the program. The application takes 5 minutes to complete and will ask you to send in your LinkedIn profile and resume, as well as ask you about why you are interested in this program. You do NOT need to have a UX resume or portfolio to apply - we consider folks who are at the very beginning of their career change, who are still exploring multiple career options.
You will receive UX tips and challenges via email to help you with your transition into UX and will be contacted by us if you are being considered for the apprentice program. Once contacted, you will go through a brief interview process before joining the cohort.

Due to the large volume of applicants, we cannot contact all applicants about their application status. If you don’t hear from us about an interview within 2 months of applying, please consider your application closed. We consider applicants on a rolling basis.

Interview candidates for positions within the organization/unit and recommend appointment, promotion or reassignment to such positions. Hear and resolve complaints from employees, refer group grievances and/or more serious unresolved complaints as appropriate.

Initiate ways to improve production, work processes and/or to increase the quality of the work directed.

The following are the job specific duties of this position. You will have the opportunity to learn to perform these duties and receive training to help you grow in this position.

Provides technical oversight of taxpayer inquiries and case resolution activities by evaluating work performed and ensuring consistent application of tax laws, regulations, and IRM procedures.

Reviews and analyzes cases involving multiple issue areas, complex regulatory requirements, and frequently changing guidance to ensure accurate and compliant resolution. Ensures employees follow established procedures for handling inventory, system usage, and case documentation requirements.

Applies advanced interviewing and analytical techniques to evaluate taxpayer circumstances, including sensitive financial and personal information, and to determine appropriate actions. Ensures proper handling of cases involving issues such as compliance determinations, financial hardship, or potential noncompliance.

Evaluates determinations made by employees to ensure sound judgment in resolving discrepancies and interpreting taxpayer intent. Ensures proper handling of sensitive taxpayer data and reinforces adherence to disclosure and privacy regulations in all case interactions.

Analyzes casework, workload data, and program trends to identify risks, recurring issues, and opportunities for improvement. Supports the development of strategies to improve efficiency, consistency, and program effectiveness.

Utilizes system-generated reports and operational data to monitor trends, identify systemic issues, and recommend corrective actions to improve program performance. Ensures accurate computation or review of tax liabilities, penalties, and assessments across a range of tax situations.

Provides technical guidance and support to employees, promoting consistent application of policies and procedures and assisting with complex or unusual cases. Advises employees on interpretation of IRM procedures, SERP guidance, and other program resources to ensure accurate and consistent case resolution.

Maintains technical proficiency by performing work consistently with the level of employees supervised, as needed. Participates in ongoing technical training and remains current on tax law changes, procedural updates, and program requirements.

The United States Space Force (USSF) in Washington D.C. is searching for a Mission Support Specialist to support DELTA 13 (NH-0343-03, GS-12/13 Equivalent). Description: Step to the leading edge of national defense and help architect the future of the United States Space Force.

In this high-impact strategic role, you will bridge the gap between cutting-edge space and cyber operations and the Pentagon's resource allocation engine.

Your expertise will directly shape how the Space Force organizes, educates, and resources its total force-translating advanced operational concepts in Space Domain Awareness, Space ISR, and multi-domain warfare into fully funded, actionable programs across the Program Objective Memorandum (POM) and Future Years Defense Program (FYDP).

Ideal Candidate: The ideal candidate is a seasoned human capital strategist, academic program manager, or military space operations professional with extensive headquarters-, Field Command-, or Delta-level staff experience in Total Force management and specialized Administratively Determined (AD) personnel systems.

They possess deep expertise in the DoD Planning, Programming, Budgeting, and Execution (PPBE) process to build, defend, and integrate Space Force education, faculty pay requirements, and human capital initiatives into the Program Objectives Memorandum (POM) and Future Years Defense Program (FYDP).

Additionally, they bring proven capability in administering complex AD faculty personnel actions, managing academic selection boards, and synchronizing requirements across Space Delta 13, STARCOM, and higher headquarters. Key Responsibilities: 1.

Coordinates end-to-end personnel lifecycle actions for Administratively Determined (AD) Faculty, including recruitment, hiring authorities, salary determinations, appointments, contract extensions, onboarding, in/out-processing, and performance management across Senior Level Education programs.

Serves as the primary personnel liaison between faculty, academic leadership and Space Delta 13. 2. Applies Department of Defense Planning, Programming, Budgeting, and Execution (PPBE) processes to forecast, formulate, and execute faculty personnel and operational budgets.

Develops Program Objectives Memoranda (POM) inputs, Budget Estimate Submissions (BES), cost projections, financial exhibits, and FYDP personnel projections/offsets for Delta 13 education programs. 3.

Synchronizes personnel actions and operational alignment for Joint military instructors, Active Duty Guardians, and Total Force personnel assigned to or augmenting Space Force educational programs. Tracks suspense management, program records, and cross-service instructor memorandums of agreement (MOAs/MOUs). 4.

Integrates Space Delta 13 faculty footprint, academic facility requirements, and classroom technology requirement. 5. Develops and standardizes Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), governance charters, business rules, and administrative tracking systems for the emerging Space Force education enterprise.

Coordinates high-level academic meetings, faculty symposiums, and Distinguished Visitor (DV) engagements. 6. Analyzes complex programmatic, personnel, and fiscal data to identify operational gaps and formulate actionable courses of action (COAs).

Drafts executive correspondence and staff summary sheets for Space Delta 13 leadership and higher headquarters.

Wir von der CSS helfen Menschen, ein gesundes Leben zu führen - was immer das Leben für sie bereithält. Vielleicht ist unsere Mission ja bald auch deine? Uns würde es freuen. Wir sind eine bunte Gruppe ehrgeiziger Menschen, die etwas bewegen wollen.

Einige von uns haben das KV gemacht, andere kommen aus dem Detailhandel, dem Gastgewerbe oder aus einer anderen beruflichen Ecke. Alle bringen ihre Erfahrung ein. Was uns verbindet, ist unsere Leidenschaft für unsere Kundinnen und Kunden da zu sein. Wir helfen einander, halten zusammen und lachen viel.

Und Erfolge feiern wir am liebsten gemeinsam im Team.
## **So sieht dein Alltag aus** ##
* Zum Herzstück: Du überzeugst Menschen von der CSS und machst sie zu Kundinnen und Kunden.
* Diese berätst du persönlich, am Telefon, per E-Mail oder auch mal per Video-Call - in sehr gutem Deutsch, gerne auch in weiteren Sprachen.
* Unser Kundenportfolio wächst dank dir durch Cross- und Upselling.
* Du arbeitest eng mit deinen Kolleginnen und Kollegen zusammen und ihr unterstützt euch gegenseitig beim Erreichen der gemeinsamen Ziele.
* Ab und zu schaust du über den Tellerrand und übernimmst Zusatzaufgaben oder Projektarbeiten.
## **Das bringst du mit** ##
* Das Wichtigste zuerst: Man merkt dir an, dass du gerne unter Menschen bist - du gehst offen auf sie zu und deine positive Art ist ansteckend.
* Eine abgeschlossene Berufsausbildung im kaufmännischen Bereich, im Detailhandel oder in einem anderen spannenden Beruf - im Idealfall mit Kundenkontakt.
* Idealerweise verfügst du über Erfahrung in der Krankenversicherungsbranche und hast bereits das VBV-Zertifikat erworben - und wenn nicht, unterstützen wir dich dabei.
* Du kannst gut auf dein Gegenüber eingehen, hörst zu und liebst es, andere im Gespräch mit starken Argumenten zu überzeugen.
* Die Digitalisierung ist für dich kein Fremdwort - du kannst gut mit dem Computer umgehen.
* Du hast ein grosses Beziehungsnetz und wohnst vorzugsweise in der Region.

Gemeinsam neue Massstäbe setzen und die Zukunft gestalten - das bedeutet für uns mehr, als Aufgaben einfach abzuarbeiten. Hier arbeitest du mit Menschen zusammen, die Verantwortung übernehmen, hohe Ansprüche haben und den Mut mitbringen, neue Wege zu gehen.

Bei uns findest du ein Umfeld, in dem Vertrauen und Leistung Hand in Hand gehen und deine Ideen, deine Initiative und dein Beitrag zählen. So hast du die Möglichkeit, wirklich etwas zu bewegen für unsere Kundinnen und Kunden, dein Team und deine persönliche Entwicklung.
## Was du bewirkst ##
* **Beratung & Betreuung mit Weitblick:** Du begleitest Privat- und Firmenkunden in allen Versicherungsfragen mit echtem Engagement und sicherst massgeschneiderte Lösungen für jedes individuelle Bedürfnis. Als Kundenberater:in bist du da, wenn es darauf ankommt.
* **Langfristige Beziehungen aufbauen:** Vertrauen steht im Zentrum deiner Arbeit - du pflegst und entwickelst nachhaltige Kundenbeziehungen, die auf deinem exzellenten Service beruhen.
* **Wachstum aktiv gestalten:** Du hast ein gutes Netzwerk und bringst deine Energie in die Akquise neuer Kundinnen und Kunden ein. Dein Engagement sorgt dafür, dass unser Kundenstamm beständig wächst. Wie können wir dich hierbei unterstützen? Indem du einen eigenen Kundenstamm mit Privat- und Firmenkunden erhältst.
* **Marketing- & Vertriebsunterstützung:** Mit frischen Ideen unterstützt du unsere Marketingaktionen, besuchst Messen und Veranstaltungen, um unser Netzwerk zu stärken.
* **Immer am Puls der Zeit:** Durch unsere Grundausbildung und kontinuierliche Weiterbildungen bleibst du fachlich auf dem neuesten Stand und bietest höchste Beratungskompetenz.
## Was du mitbringst ##
* **Erfahrung & Expertise:** Du bringst Erfahrung in der Kundenberatung oder im Verkauf mit - optimalerweise in der Finanz- oder Versicherungsbranche. Auch ambitionierte Quereinsteiger:innen, die bereit sind schnell durchzustarten sind herzlich willkommen.
* **Kommunikationstalent:** Menschen begeistern und gewinnen - das liegt dir im Blut. Du glänzt durch Kommunikations- und Verhandlungsstärke. Du kannst als Kundenberater:in überzeugend argumentieren und verfügst über stilsichere Deutschkenntnisse.
* **Dienstleistung ist deine Stärke:** Der Aussendienst ist deine Leidenschaft und deine hohe Kundenorientierung sowie Servicebereitschaft zeichnen dich aus.
* **Engagement & Eigeninitiative:** Mit überdurchschnittlicher Motivation und Unternehmergeist bist du bereit, Grosses zu erreichen und Ziele zu übertreffen.
* **Regionale Verankerung:** Dein Wohnort liegt in der Region Oberbüren oder Uzwil, in welcher du deine Kundinnen und Kunden betreust. Du verfügst über ein starkes Netzwerk in dieser Region und schätzt es, neue Kontakte aufzubauen und zu pflegen.
Bereit, Kundinnen und Kunden mit Leidenschaft zu begeistern und mit uns zu wachsen? Dann setze dein Talent gezielt ein und bewirb dich jetzt!

How to Prepare for the Recruiting Process -
📢 Why Are They Hiring an Insurance Customer Service Representative?
Our client is on a mission to bring calm to the chaos of commercial insurance—and they need a rockstar Customer Service Representative to help make that happen.

As their client base grows, so does the need for someone who can keep everything organized and on track: answering calls, replying to emails, processing billing and certificates, managing policy updates, and making sure renewals don’t slip through the cracks.

The team is lean, experienced, and high-performing—but they’re ready to hand off the operational load so they can stay focused on what matters.
This is your chance to be the backbone of the operation—bringing order, accuracy, and a personal touch to a team that truly values great service. If you thrive in fast-paced environments and love being the calm in the storm, this is where you belong. 🚀

Strong working knowledge of insurance operations, particularly in commercial lines
Familiarity with insurance terminology, policy documents, and servicing workflows
Excellent communication skills—both written and verbal—with the ability to handle client interactions professionally
Strong attention to detail, organizational skills, and the ability to prioritize in a fast-paced environment
Experience or exposure to construction or contractor insurance is a HUGE plus!
Ideally using Apple products (Mac, iPhone) and are fluent in tools like Numbers, Pages, and iMessage for seamless collaboration.
Responsibilities of the Insurance Customer Service Representative:

📞 Client Communication & Frontline Support
Serve as the first point of contact by answering inbound calls on the agency's main line; this may also include making outbound follow-up calls when necessary
Handle approximately 17–20 phone calls per day, ranging from quickinquiries to more in-depth conversations
Monitor and manage the shared service inbox, which is color-coded and collaboratively used by multiple team members
Triage, flag, and forward incoming emails appropriately; long-term expectation is for the Insurance CSR to assess incoming correspondence, identify required actions, and assign or tag tasks independently
Draft and send welcome emails to new clients
Retrieve and forward necessary documents from insurance carriers to internal service staff
Respond to client requests for Certificates of Insurance (COIs), additional insured endorsements, and proofs of insurance, ensuring accuracy and compliance
🛠️ Policy Servicing & Endorsements
Process a wide range of policy changes, including updates to addresses, names, business entities, or ownership structures
Submit, track, and follow up on endorsements and miscellaneous changes, working closely with carriers and internal stakeholders
Request and issue required auto filings as needed for commercial clients

Manage updates to commercial auto policies, including the addition or removal of drivers and vehicles.
Ensure all vehicle schedules are updated accurately in Veruna
💳 Billing, Payments & Compliance
Accept and process direct bill payments with the highest level of discretion, compliance, and data security
Maintain accurate logs of all financial transactions in the CRM and related systems
Generate and send invoices via email and DocuSign one to two times per week
Manage and process renewal invoices, confirmations, and direct bill (DB) cancellations
Maintain organized logs for login credentials, endorsements, renewals, and cancellations
🔁 Renewal Tracking & Support
Track and monitor upcoming renewals, particularly for direct bill or automatic policy renewals.
Record and update renewal details—including effective dates and premiums—into the CRM system
Upload and organize renewal documents (e.g., declarations pages, binders, ID cards) into both Veruna and Google Drive
Communicate renewal statuses to clients and support retention efforts through proactive follow-ups
Update certificate templates, contractor license boards (e.g., for Workers’ Comp policies), and internal spreadsheets to reflect current policy information
Coordinate with carriers such as Guard, Progressive, and Mercury to obtain renewal documents and ensure completeness of files.
🗂️ Data Management & Documentation
Collect and consolidate data from multiple insurance policies for processing and documentation
Upload endorsements and supporting documents into Veruna and Google Drive with precision and consistency
Regularly clean up and organize folders by archiving outdated certificates and ensuring file structures are up to date
Assist in the creation, maintenance, and refinement of internal Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) related to service and policy workflows
🏡 Want to Know More About the Client?
Our client is a modern-day trailblazer in the world of commercial insurance, serving contractors and small-to-medium businesses for over a decade across California, Arizona, Nevada, Texas, and beyond.

With a laser-sharp focus on compliance, renewals, and risk management, they’ve built their reputation on delivering boutique-style service with big-league results. From the high-stakes world of construction coverage to personalized risk consultancy, this lean, powerhouse agency brings clarity and confidence to its clients' insurance decisions.
Their mission? To simplify the complex, protect what matters, and scale smartly—without ever losing their human touch. Their remote team is tight-knit, upbeat, and motivated by one simple rule: take care of the customer, take care of each other, and take pride in your day’s work. 🌟

We are Digital Science and we are advancing the research ecosystem.
We are a pioneering technology company, and our vision is of a future where a trusted and collaborative research ecosystem drives progress for all. We believe in better, open, collaborative and inclusive research.

In creating the next generation of tools and working in partnership with the community we tackle some of the biggest challenges to research. In order to achieve our vision, we need innovative, inspiring and dynamic people to join our team. Want to join us?

Your new role Digital Science is dedicated to putting customers at the heart of everything we do.

Our portfolio spans products at different stages of maturity — from Overleaf, our widely used scientific and technical writing platform that serves over 30 million researchers, students, and institutions worldwide, to Papers AI, one of our newest research software products, which launched on July 29, 2026 and is growing quickly.

Our goal is to provide exceptional support, empower users through self-service resources, and continuously improve the experience across both products.

The Customer Support Specialist role is the connective tissue between two products within Digital Science : Overleaf, our mature, widely-used scientific and technical writing platform built around LaTeX and collaborative authoring, and Papers AI, our newest AI-powered research and writing
tool. You'll deliver hands-on, empathetic support to Overleaf's global base of researchers and institutions, and to Papers AI's early adopters, still shaping its support experience as it grows.
Please note - due to business need, we can only accept applications from candidates who reside in the UK and the US where we have established legal entities.
If you apply from outside of these areas, your application will not be considered.
Please be aware that we may close this position early if we receive a high volume of applications, so we encourage you to apply promptly.
What you’ll be doing
Provide timely, professional, and empathetic email-based support to B2C and B2B users of both Overleaf and Papers AI.
Handle billing inquiries for both products (e.g., Stripe-based subscriptions), escalating complex billing or account issues as needed.
Maintain and improve Overleaf’s existing documentation and knowledge base, while building Papers AI’s user-facing help content largely from scratch as common issues emerge.
Log bug reports to Product and Engineering with clear, reproducible detail.
Adhere to and refine Overleaf’s established support processes, and help shape a first support playbook for Papers AI as ticket patterns emerge.
Collaborate cross-functionally with Product, Engineering, Sales, Marketing, Customer Engagement, and Finance teams to support individual users, institutional clients, and enterprise customers across both products.
Monitor support trends and user feedback across both products, and proactively surface patterns that show up.

Excellent written and verbal communication skills for engaging with customers and internal teams.
Fluency in English, with strong attention to detail and clarity.
Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to troubleshoot technical issues efficiently, across products with different levels of process maturity.
Comfort working through ambiguity — Papers AI is early-stage and doesn’t have a mature playbook yet, so some days will look more like building the answer than looking it up.
Experience in a customer service or support role, preferably within a SaaS platform.
Ability to quickly learn and explain technical subjects to users of varying expertise levels, across more than one product at a time.
Comfortable working remotely and independently while collaborating with a distributed team.

Familiarity with LaTeX, Overleaf, or similar markup languages and authoring tools.
Familiarity with AI-assisted writing or research tools, or a general interest in AI-powered research software.
Experience using Front or other customer service management systems.
Knowledge of SaaS billing platforms such as Stripe.
Experience working remotely in a distributed team environment.
Understanding of academic publishing and the needs of researchers and institutions.
Experience supporting more than one product at once, or building support documentation and processes from scratch for an early-stage product.
We're looking for people who are naturally curious about AI and comfortable exploring how it can improve the way we work — you don't need to be an AI expert, but an openness to experiment and adapt is important to us.
Don't worry if you don't meet every qualification—let us be the judge! We invest in, nurture and support innovative businesses and technologies that make all parts of the research process more open, efficient and effective.

We are brave in the pursuit of better

We firmly believe that to truly innovate and solve the complex challenges faced by our customers, from researchers and universities to funders and publishers, we need diverse perspectives, experiences, and ideas. Remote | Gastroenterology | Part-Time, 40 hours/week | Rate: $6.5/hour

This Gastroenterology practice is looking for a highly organized, patient-focused Bilingual Medical Scheduling & Patient Support Specialist to support its clinics in two locations in Texas.
This role is heavily focused on appointment scheduling and patient communication , with a high daily call volume of approximately 70 to 90 calls per day . The ideal candidate is comfortable working in a fast-paced healthcare environment, managing multiple communication channels, and maintaining accurate patient documentation.

1. Appointment Scheduling
Handle approximately 70 to 90 inbound and outbound calls daily related to appointments for the Lewisville and Denton locations.
Schedule, reschedule, and cancel patient appointments while ensuring accurate and timely communication with patients.
Maintain and update provider schedules in RingCentral and eClinicalWorks (eCW) based on availability and scheduling requirements.
2. Fax Management
Send and receive faxes involving patient records, referrals, insurance documents, and other clinical or administrative information.
Review incoming fax communications and route documents to the appropriate provider, department, or patient record.
Accurately log, upload, and organize faxed documentation within the clinic's systems.
3. Language Interpretation Support
Provide occasional language interpretation assistance between patients and clinic staff when needed.
Help ensure medical and administrative information is communicated clearly and accurately across language barriers.
Maintain professionalism, confidentiality, and accuracy when assisting with patient-provider communication.
4. Outbound Calling
Conduct outbound calls for appointment reminders, follow-ups, patient updates, and care coordination.
Contact insurance companies, referring providers, pharmacies, or other healthcare offices when necessary.
Document call outcomes, follow-up requirements, and relevant information accurately in the patient's record.
5. Patient Text Messaging
Send appointment confirmations, reminders, updates, and other approved patient communications through text messaging.
Monitor and collect patient responses and escalate questions or concerns to the appropriate clinic team member when needed.
Document relevant text conversations and patient responses in RingCentral and eCW to maintain continuity of care.
6. Billing and Payment Reminder Support
Contact patients regarding outstanding balances, billing reminders, or upcoming payment obligations as instructed by the clinic.
Provide basic payment-related information and direct patients to the appropriate billing resource when additional assistance is required.

Previous experience in medical administration, medical virtual assistance, patient scheduling, front desk support, or a similar healthcare role is strongly preferred.
Comfortable handling a high-volume call environment , including approximately 70 to 90 calls per day.
Experience using eClinicalWorks (eCW) and RingCentral is highly preferred.
Strong verbal and written English communication skills with a professional and patient-friendly approach.
Strong attention to detail, organization, documentation, and ability to manage multiple tasks throughout the workday.
Experience supporting a gastroenterology or specialty medical practice is an advantage.
Ability to communicate in an additional language and provide interpretation support is an advantage.
Ideal Candidate
The ideal candidate is confident speaking with patients throughout the day, comfortable managing a high volume of appointments and communications, and able to stay organized while supporting two clinic locations. You should be dependable, detail-oriented, professional, and capable of providing a positive patient experience while maintaining accurate documentation.
